connector.name: Prospeo MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Prospeo: Find, search, and enrich people and companies with verified emails and mobile numbers.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.prospeo.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package prospeo-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace io.prospeo. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
